ruling: Only mb_enrichment_task and library_enrichment_task share a task-run lifecycle envelope (backend/tasks/_task_run.task_run). library_scan_task, library_scan_files_task (watcher), ingestion_task and library_hash_backfill_task keep their own envelopes, and task_failure_telemetry keeps its FAILED-only contract.

Unifying them would change behaviour. The enrichment pair is the one shape AUD-025's evidence covers (9 shared commits). Lance ruled 2026-09-29; the behaviour differences are addressed separately by declared fixes (see AUD-R012 when recorded).

ruling: (1) Chained task calls are Huey enqueues; a chained task's run failure is its own to report. The caller owns only the handoff: if enqueueing the next task fails, the caller writes an ERROR SystemLog `<next_task>_enqueue_failed` (error + traceback, on its own task_id) and keeps its own COMPLETED status. Applies to library_scan_task, the watcher (library_scan_files_task), library_enrichment_task and ingestion_task. (2) The watcher and ingestion_task write started / completed / failed SystemLogs like their peers. (3) Failed-run SystemLogs carry a traceback: library_scan_task and _error_boundary.task_failure_telemetry (artist matching, identity matching, embedding, normalize backfill, hash backfill).
rationale: Lance, 2026-09-29, after the AUD-021/025 gate-0 inventory showed enqueue failures were handled three different ways (flipping a successful scan/watcher run to FAILED, escaping unrecorded from library enrichment, silently swallowed by ingestion) and two tasks left no SystemLog trail. Implemented by PR #114, squash-merged to master as d89faf7 on 2026-09-29. Only the SqliteHuey storage error (sqlite3.Error) counts as a failed handoff; any other exception from the enqueue call is a defect and propagates.
supersedes: ingestion_tasks comment 'a broker hiccup here is a separate operational concern' implemented as suppress(Exception): the concern stays separate, but it is now logged

ruling: Every task-to-task hand-off (a Huey task enqueueing another task) goes through backend/tasks/_enqueue_chain.enqueue_or_log; a hand-off outside it is an EV01 finding of the event-graph audit. This extends AUD-R012 (1) beyond the four tasks it names, and covers artist_matching_task -> identity_matching_task (artist_matching_tasks.py:110), embedding_task -> artist_matching_task (embedding_tasks.py:68) and the periodic library_watcher_poll -> library_scan_files_task (library_watcher_tasks.py:102). The event-graph run passes every task name to --ev01-scope.
rationale: Lance, 2026-10-03, at Gate A of the event-graph audit (audit/eda/state.json): the Session A inventory found three unguarded task-to-task hand-offs whose producers AUD-R012 does not name, so EV01 would have marked them ruling_scope: unstated. Standard job-queue practice is one rule for every hand-off, enforced by a check, not a list of tasks. No code change is made by this ruling; fixes are decided in Session C.

ruling: RetroStation's background work is a command pipeline and is documented as one. A Huey message is a command to one named consumer that carries a scope (an id, or nothing). The work items live in status columns, which form the hand-off contract: broadcast_artists/track_identities.match_status (+ reason_code DEFERRED_RETRY), library_files.audio_hash IS NULL, library_files.enrichment_status, artists/works/recordings.needs_enhancement, stream_cues absence (stream_cue_work.NEEDS_ANALYSIS), library_folder_staged_hashes. Periodic tasks reconcile what a lost or failed command left behind. class.EVENT = 0 in the event graph is the expected state, not a defect. The contract is written once, in ARCHITECTURE.md (repo root).
rationale: Lance ruled 2026-10-05 on the Session C open questions (audit/eda/report.md section 10), answer Q7: target shape (b), command pipeline named honestly. Event graph 2026-10-04 (audit/eda/report.md): 14/14 messages COMMAND, 0 EVENT, 0 QUERY, max fan-out 2, unchanged in shape since April (7 -> 12 -> 14). All seven judged modules coordinate through the columns above, and that is why duplicate delivery is harmless. No consumer exists that an announcement would serve that a named command does not already serve.

ruling: Huey signals are not adopted. Task lifecycle reporting stays in the per-task envelopes ruled by AUD-R011 and AUD-R012 (task_run, task_failure_telemetry, own try/except, reported_failures). The event-graph analyzer keeps counting a signal handler as EVENT (spec D2 unchanged); a future signal edge is a gate hit to review, not a goal.
rationale: Lance ruled 2026-10-05 on the Session C open questions (audit/eda/report.md section 10), answer Q3: do not adopt Huey signals. Closes the question Session B deferred to Session C (state.json open_questions). Signals fire in the consumer process after the fact and would duplicate the envelopes' rows and SystemLogs. AUD-R011 already ruled the envelopes distinct on purpose, and no defect found on 2026-10-04 is a lifecycle-reporting gap that a signal would fix.
supersedes: .claude/rules/design-pattern-signals.md 'Logging/metrics/audit calls sprinkled in domain functions -> Observer pattern', narrowed: it does not apply to Huey task lifecycle, which AUD-R011/R012 govern

ruling: Each Huey consumer (huey, cue_huey) runs exactly one worker (Procfile -w 1). This is a constraint, not a tuning value. Raising it first needs run exclusion on library_enrichment_task, mb_enrichment_task and the hash backfill (huey lock_task or pg_try_advisory_lock), a cross-process MusicBrainz rate limit, and the guarded writes of AUD-R018. The constraint is stated in a Procfile comment and in ARCHITECTURE.md.
rationale: Lance ruled 2026-10-05 on the Session C open questions (audit/eda/report.md section 10), answer Q4: no, one worker per queue. Duplicate-delivery safety of four tasks, the MB 1.1 s cadence (process-local threading.Lock, mb_client.py:24-43) and backfill_is_live (check-then-act) all rest on serial execution today, and nothing in the code says so.

ruling: The event graph is a blocking gate. `poe events-check` runs scripts/audit/event_graph.py --check audit/event-graph.baseline.json in the CI lint job and as a pre-commit hook on backend/ and scripts/ Python files. A new hit identity or unresolved_dispatch fails the build. The baseline is refreshed (`poe events-baseline`) only in the PR that introduces the change, with the reason in the PR body. `poe events` joins `poe audit`.
rationale: Lance ruled 2026-10-05 on the Session C open questions (audit/eda/report.md section 10), answer Q5: accept the gate, including a baseline refresh in the PR that adds a task or producer. AUD-R014 asks for 'one rule for every hand-off, enforced by a check, not a list of tasks'. The analyzer is stdlib-only, deterministic (no timestamps) and reran identically on HEAD and master a97a64a on 2026-10-04.

ruling: A task is chained after another only when it reads the other's output. embedding_task becomes a side branch: ingestion_task hands off to embedding_task and artist_matching_task separately, both through enqueue_or_log, and embedding_tasks.py:68 is removed. Revisit if a matching strategy starts reading vectors.
rationale: Lance ruled 2026-10-05 on the Session C open questions (audit/eda/report.md section 10), answer Q2: embeddings are not planned for matching; run embedding as a side branch. No backend query reads an embedding (no <=>/<->/<#> operator; only IS NULL selects and UPDATEs), yet an embedding failure stops all matching. Depends on open question 2 in audit/eda/report.md (are vectors planned to be read?).

ruling: A worker-side write that completes a status-column work item is guarded on the status it read (UPDATE ... WHERE id = %s AND <status> = <read status>) and checks rowcount, so a decision written meanwhile by the API process (e.g. resolve_artist MANUAL_MATCHED) wins. Applies first to broadcast_artists.update_match_status on the worker path and library_files.update_recording_link.
rationale: Lance ruled 2026-10-05: yes to AUD-R018. The API and the worker are separate processes, so -w 1 (AUD-R017) does not serialise them. broadcast_artists.py:108-111 overwrites a manual match made during a matching run (AUD-060).
